known: Prior96monthlystorage cases,FAO component checks and supplied clock were exposed. Published FAO31 bare-soil backgroundET0.15ETo is known; no new daily river/pond/field outputs inspected. No local soil/crop calendar or independent region qualified.
contract: Use the existing supplied fractional clock and soil model. Incoming river sources are m3 PERSTEP,not rates;rain is mm PERSTEP;ETo and infiltration/diffusive coefficients are daily rates;field area is m2. Node withdrawals spend water once upstream-to-downstream;all fields on a node share actual useful delivery in proportion to their requests. Paid conveyance losses separate from delivered water. No default harvest or settlement change.
operator: At stepstart,drain previous pond if pond_allowed=false. Add0.8rain to surface supply;0.2rain recorded as excluded runoff. Maximum soil infiltration=min(current soil storage deficit,supplied rate*actualstepdays). Useful river request=max(infiltration allowance+allowed pondroom-current surface supply,0) onlywhere captureenabled. Route aggregate useful requests through conserved forest with explicit efficiency;split useful delivery proportionally. Infiltrate up to same soil/rate limit;retain remaining surfacewater up to supplied pondcap whenallowed;rest drains externally. Pond evaporation=min(retained pond,pondcoefficient*ETo*dt). If pond was present after infiltration,suppress soil evaporation/diffusion for entire step;drylandcrop cannot overlap pondallowed. Soil evaporation/root extraction or bare diffusion then operate. Drainage and runoff are external sinks,no instant downstream recycling,groundwater or returnflow.
bare_operator: Paid wetting/drainage as in existing soil model. SurfaceKr/Ke use supplied bare background coefficient in place of Kcb. Surface evaporation spends topavailable then surfacebelowWP;basal diffusive evaporation separately spends only deeper available water,at min(suppliedbackground*ETo*dt,deepstock). No crop root uptake outsidecrop. FAO31 profileFC0.25,WP0.10,Zr1m,Ze0.1m,REW9,initialfullywet,background0.15,ETo4.5,Kcmax1.2 must reproduce its ten-day surface and totalET columns. Backgroundrate after deep depletion is an unvalidated bounded approximation.
initial_and_cycle: Defaultsoil/pond empty. Periodic replay carries all three soilstocks and pondstock from previous year;no fieldcapacity reset. Require every stock annual difference<=1e-6mm within50cycles;nonconvergence explicit and unscored. Initial/surface/river/field/ET/loss/drainage ledgers kept separately.
controls: Before Earth outputs:test complete bareFAO31,belowWP/root restrictions,shared-node area/efficiency rationing,upstream nonreuse,pondclosure and paid evaporation,no double pond+soil ET,netrain runoff,emptyinitialstock,partialstep units,nonconvergence,invalid bindings/calendars. Independent scalar bare and joint ledgers,forest routing and complete state histories;fresh numeric replay.
